Sacrificed themselves to revive [[Cartethyia]]}} {{Lang|'''Imperator'''|zh=}} is the [[Sentinel]] of [[Rinascita]]. They wield the power to split and manipulate space. Their form was originally that of a Pegasus, but they became a hippocampus after being corrupted by and merging with [[Leviathan]], the [[Rinascita]]n Threnodian. ==Overview== The [[Carnevale]], the grandest celebration in [[Ragunna]], is held as a tribute to Imperator and Their deeds. It is said that Imperator will manifest at the peak of the Carnevale and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel", which grants the bearer the rare opportunity to commune with the Sentinel and receive Their wisdom. It is at odds with the [[Threnodian]] [[Leviathan]]. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Gallery== File:Wuthering Waves Story Cinematics - Enlightened One File:Imperator true form 01.png|Imperator original form as a Pegasus. File:Imperator true form 02.png ==Trivia== *There has been several mentions thus far that the people of [[Ragunna]] may be incorrect about Imperator's identity. **[[Ariosto]], an undercover [[Black Shores]] agent stationed in Ragunna, states that the statues in the city do not match the description of Imperator in the their records. **Upon inspecting a tablet in the Seminary of the Forgotten, [[Phoebe]] comments that the figure of the Sentinel doesn't quite look like the statues. [[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]] **It is revealed in [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]] that Imperator's original form was that of a Pegasus, and it only assumed the Sea-Horse form after merging with [[Leviathan]] during the First Dark Tide. ===Etymology=== *"Imperator" was a title used in the Roman Republic, originally granted temporarily to victorious generals before later being used as part of an Emperor's titulature. It is derived from the word ''imperare'', meaning 'to order, to command'. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Imperator |zhs = 英白拉多 |zht = 英白拉多 |ja = インペラトル |ko = 임페라토르 |es = Imperator |fr = Imperator |de = Imperator |pt = Imperator }} ==References== [[Category:Deceased Characters]] [[zh:英白拉多]]
